description_en: Queries the information about resource groups of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster. You can call this operation only for AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode for Cluster Edition
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBResourcePool接口查询集群的资源组信息。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
name: DescribeDBResourcePool

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: pool_name

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource group was created

NodeNum.description_en:
The number of nodes.

Each node consumes 16 cores and 64 GB memory

节点数量。
1个节点的资源量为16核64 GB

PoolName.description_en: The name of the resource group

PoolUsers.description_en: The database accounts that are associated with the resource group

batch
